reference.container: LZMA-Alone: properties byte 0x5d (lc=3, lp=0, pb=2), 4-byte little-endian dictionary size 0x00800000, 8-byte little-endian unknown unpacked size 0xffffffffffffffff, range-coded payload and end-of-stream marker
reference.encoder: lzma-rs encode::dumbencoder (literal-only range coder; no LZ77 match finder)
reference.ratio_definition: compressed_bytes / prepared_prose_bytes; empty helper input returns 1.0
reference.entropy_definition: Shannon entropy in bits over case-sensitive whitespace-separated prepared-prose tokens: -sum p*log2(p); no tokens => 0.0
reference.entropy_reference: Python 3 standard library collections.Counter and math.log2
reference.plain_text_preparation: Document::from_stdin_text(text, false) appends one block-boundary newline to nonempty prose and leaves empty prose empty
reference.notes: These are original synthetic native regression vectors, not a corpus and not Python lzma preset-6 parity. Entropy is independently reproducible with the Python standard library; LZMA ratios are pinned outputs of the recorded native encoder/container.
reference.lzma_stream_validation: Encoded LZMA-Alone bytes are pinned as hex and SHA-256; scripts/check-compression-reference.py decompresses them with Python stdlib lzma.FORMAT_ALONE and checks exact raw bytes, length, and ratio. This validates the container/stream, not compression-quality parity with Python lzma preset 6.
